difficulty_why: Linear allows any external workspace to authorize third-party OAuth apps immediately without app review, fees, or install caps. You only need a standard free Linear workspace with admin permissions to create credentials.

dev_time.label: 10-15 min
dev_time.text: Creating a free Linear workspace, navigating to API settings, and registering an OAuth application to generate client credentials.

launch_time.label: Immediate
launch_time.text: Any customer workspace can authorize and use the OAuth application immediately upon creation without undergoing a review or waiting for approval.

own_app_reasons.label: Custom branding on consent screen
own_app_reasons.text: Display your own product name and logo on the Linear OAuth consent screen when customers connect their workspaces.

own_app_reasons.label: Custom scopes and actor authorization
own_app_reasons.text: Configure custom scopes or use actor=app authorization to allow your integration to act as an application bot rather than an individual user.

app_type.label: OAuth 2.0 Application
app_type.text: OAuth 2.0 Application registered under Workspace Settings > Administration > API. Linear uses OAuth 2.0 applications for third-party integrations connecting to Linear accounts.

prerequisites.label: Workspace Admin permissions
prerequisites.text: Linear account with Workspace Admin permissions is required to access Settings > Administration > API and manage OAuth applications.

prerequisites.label: Linear account on any tier
prerequisites.text: A Linear workspace on any plan (including the free tier); no paid subscription or credit card is required to register an OAuth application.

prerequisites.label: Dedicated workspace recommendation
prerequisites.text: Linear recommends creating a dedicated workspace to manage OAuth applications because all admins have access to client secrets.

steps.label: Navigate to API Settings
steps.text: Log in to Linear with a workspace admin account and navigate to Settings > Administration > API.

steps.label: Create New OAuth Application
steps.text: Under the OAuth Applications section, click 'Create new' to open the application registration form.

steps.label: Configure Application Details
steps.text: Enter your application name, the Composio callback redirect URL, and select the required scopes.

steps.label: Copy Client Credentials
steps.text: Submit the form to generate your Client ID and Client Secret, and securely record them for Composio.

scopes.label: read
scopes.text: Default scope granting read access to workspace data. Always present and available without review.

scopes.label: write
scopes.text: Grants write access across the user's workspace. Available immediately without review.

scopes.label: issues:create
scopes.text: Allows creating and updating issues and attachments. Available immediately without review.

scopes.label: comments:create
scopes.text: Allows creating new comments on issues. Available immediately without review.

approval.label: When required
approval.text: OAuth app review is not required for external workspaces to authorize or install an application; review is only required for listing in the public Linear Integration Directory.

approval.label: Install cap before review
approval.text: No cap found. Any external Linear workspace or user can authorize and install an unreviewed, unlisted OAuth application via its authorization URL.

approval.label: Limits until reviewed
approval.text: Standard OAuth app rate limits apply before directory listing: 5,000 requests per hour and 2,000,000 complexity points per hour per user or app user.

approval.label: What's checked
approval.text: Linear evaluates whether the app provides community value, is built by a formal company, and includes required marketing copy and visual assets (320x320 icons and 1600x1000 showcase images).

approval.label: Wait
approval.text: Linear does not publish an official review turnaround timeframe or SLA for Integration Directory submissions.

approval.label: Cost
approval.text: Linear does not charge any fee for OAuth app creation or Integration Directory listing.

pitfalls.label: Admin credential visibility
pitfalls.text: Every workspace admin has access to view and manage OAuth application credentials; Linear recommends creating a dedicated workspace to manage OAuth apps.

pitfalls.label: 24-hour token expiration
pitfalls.text: OAuth access tokens expire after 24 hours (86399 seconds), requiring refresh token handling to maintain persistent connectivity.

pitfalls.label: Form URL-encoded header requirement
pitfalls.text: Token exchange requests to https://api.linear.app/oauth/token must set the Content-Type header to application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

pitfalls.label: Workspace third-party app approvals gate
pitfalls.text: Customer workspaces with third-party app approvals enabled require an admin to approve the OAuth app before members can authorize it.

pitfalls.label: Directory listing rejections
pitfalls.text: Linear rejects scripts, low-effort tools, and apps built by hobbyists when applying for public Integration Directory listing.

support.label: Linear Slack Community #api channel
support.text: Linear provides developer support via the official Linear Slack community in the dedicated #api channel.

support.label: Linear Developer Documentation
support.text: Official Linear documentation for OAuth 2.0 authentication, GraphQL API guides, and rate limits.

email_subject: OAuth Application Inquiry - AI Integration for Linear
email_body:
Hi Linear Team,

We are developing an AI agent product that connects to Linear workspaces via OAuth 2.0 so users can manage issues and comments ([Product URL]).

We have registered an OAuth application in our workspace with the following configuration:
- Redirect URI: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add
- Requested Scopes: read, write, issues:create, comments:create

We would like to confirm:
1. Are there any restrictions, authorization quotas, or workspace limits for unlisted OAuth applications distributing directly to external customer workspaces via OAuth URL?
2. If we decide to submit our integration to the Linear Integration Directory in the future, what is your current review turnaround time?
3. Are there any additional security or verification requirements for integrations handling issue and comment creation?

Best regards,
[Name]
[Company / Product]
[Contact Information]

observed.label: App creation login gate
observed.text: Navigating to https://linear.app/settings/api/applications/new while unauthenticated redirected to the Linear login and signup screen.

observed.label: Self-serve signup options
observed.text: The signup page provides self-serve options to Continue with Google, Continue with email, and Continue with SAML SSO without requiring a credit card.

observed.text: The pricing page offers a Free tier ($0) that does not require a credit card.
